items.name: PCI DSS
items.scope: Any property storing, processing, or transmitting card data for deposits or folio settlement.
items.notes: Compliance is typically achieved via a PCI-validated payment gateway (scope reduction), not by storing card data directly.

items.name: GDPR — guest personal data
items.jurisdiction: European Union (and any property processing EU residents' data)
items.scope: Collection, storage, and retention of guest identity documents, contact details, and stay/preference history.
items.notes: Applies regardless of property location if EU residents' data is processed; retention limits and right-to-erasure must be designed in, not bolted on.

items.name: Guest ID/passport registration requirements
items.jurisdiction: varies by country (many jurisdictions require hotels to record ID/passport details for some or all guests)
items.scope: Capturing and retaining identity document details at check-in.
items.notes: Illustrative only — requirement, retention period, and which guests are covered (e.g. foreign nationals only) vary sharply by country; verify per deployment jurisdiction, never assumed from this entry.

provenance.notes: No authoritative single source verified across jurisdictions in this pass; general background only.
